text: Hello everyone. And welcome to another
track guide. This week we're going
around Oran Park, the South layout. It's
a very, very short track. It's very fun.
Let's get into it.
For turn one, you want to be all the way
on the right, as close as you can to the
wall. This is going to be our hardest
braking zone. And unfortunately, I don't
have a clear braking marker for you. I
brake about two car lengths before the
wall turns green. It will take some
learning. Once you get it down, you want
to brake hard, and you want to brake all
the way into the corner. Once I get to
the green wall, I'll start to turn in.
And I'm easing off the brake all the way
to the curb. Once I get to the curb, I
stay there, and I hug it all the way
around. I aim to exit the corner in the
middle of the track or on the left. You
want to do that so you can set up for
the next corner. Once I've passed midway
on the corner, I go on the throttle. If
you pass the middle of the track on the
exit, you've gone on the throttle too
fast.
For turn two, you only need to lift. I
lift when I get to the curb here on the
left. I lift in various stages to keep
the car settled. On the curb on the
inside, you want to take as much as you
can. Once you can see you will take all
the curb, go full throttle again. And of
course, use all of the curb on the
outside. But, mind the grass. Turn four,
my braking marker is the curb here on
the right. I do a quick hit on the brake
to about 40% and get it off quickly
again. Once I've done that, I'll turn
in. And I only take the colored curb
here on the left. You can take more of
it, but I found it more reliable to not.
Once I get to the curb, I go full
throttle. And of course, I use all of
the curb on the outside. Take too much,
and you'll end up in the gravel here.
For turn five and six, you want to take
both of the curbs. You can gain quite a
lot of time if you take all of the curb
and the white stuff for turn six. Turn
seven is going to be important if you
want to overtake into turn one. I brake
just before I hit the bottom of the
hill. You have to brake a little bit
earlier than you think. But, the
compression will help you. I brake hard
in the beginning because we have the
compression to help. And then I ease off
the brake all the way to the curb. My
apex is late in the corner, just after
the rubbered-in part of the curb. Once
you get to the rubbered-in part, you
want to go full throttle. And then you
want to ease the car out towards the
wall. If you carry too much speed here,
you will hit the wall. And if you're
lucky, it won't hurt the car. And that's
a lap around Oran
the South Loop. Really fun short track,
sub 43 seconds. That's insane. The
racing here is going to be crazy.
Hopefully this has helped you gain some
time. If it has, leave a like down
below. Consider subscribing as well. And
now for the uninterrupted hot laps.
Woo!
